mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies around the Verona Area High School with a temperature of 66 degrees and a waning crescent moon visible.
The City of Verona manages its infrastructure by contracting with AECOM Inc. for ongoing engineering services, with updates and reports presented at every City Council meeting.

Today you can enjoy the Dane County Farmers Market or live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Ice Arena is hosting a free Girls Try Hockey event.
In a notable update, on July 31st, an officer conducted a traffic stop that led to the arrest of a driver for an O W I and additional citations for vehicle registration issues.
The flavor of the day is the Andes Mint Avalanche. The shop is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM. If you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor is Snickers Swirl.
